6545b42c cleanup of the debug code: * reduce to a few, supported functions. * change all functions to take the debug level as parameter. * use symbolic names for the debug levels. * fix tools to pass "verbose"/"opt_debug" as ctx->debug.
d22a2483 Header file cleanup.
91da9ab8 fix memory leak
f0484968 merge changes 0.11.11 -> 0.11.12
ea370692 Merged r3749:3758 from trunk
d672fde4 Remove sc_error and sc_ctx_suppress_errors_* in favor of sc_debug/fprintf
4acfe6b0 fix compiler/sparse warnings.
b3ad2f9d convert to utf-8.
b45617c4 Make absolute paths from all paths read from the PKCS#15 directories by prepending the DF(PKCS#15) path if necessary. Fixes compatibility with Siemens HiPath SIcurity formatted cards which use relative paths.
e8c05ca6 use more opensc specific names for ASN.1 tags to avoid name conflicts with other ASN.1 libraries
6abeaf1f add a new function     void sc_mem_clear(void *ptr, size_t len); to clear a memory buffer. If OpenSSL is used this function is a wrapper for OPENSSL_cleanse, otherwise memset is currenlty used.
23802d82 properly initialize sc_asn1_entry elements + some cleanup
2d970028 API fixup: use defined type instead of struct for exposed structs
bd02c1a6 add data field for subject Common{Private|Public}KeyAttributes
8673508a fix memory leak, cleanup: use object specific release method
